correctness.rationale: Every matrix gives a strict affine contraction on the left mass and preserves the span of its individual fixed points. A positive-probability run of one type arbitrarily close to the observation time drives the pullback mass arbitrarily close to that fixed point, proving both exact essential endpoints for each fixed epsilon. Independence of the current iid type from the past pullback mass gives stationary mean and variance via an exact one-step recurrence. The admissible epsilon makes all contraction factors positive and the variance denominator strictly positive. check.py reproduced 2,040 exact finite-history states and 64 moment identities. These tests support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Averaged metastable weights are often presented with environmental-uniform convergence. The sharp iff boundary and exact epsilon-independent essential range distinguish this strong mode from genuine O(sqrt epsilon) mean-square averaging, giving a substantive interpretation boundary for rare-switching cocycles. The explicit positive iid two-type witness is natural and does not depend on an arbitrary parameter slice.
